value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard forces door_open before the box, so no separate Existence(door_open) is needed. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed'. blocker_moved and has_door_key are implied by the door constraints, so no clauses are needed for them.

The door must be opened before the box is taken.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.
